title: Yara and the Cipher Again
author: I. M. Joubert
blurb: Ansel Joubert, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
